items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: So Grant Williams joined the band... so this being Grant Williams' home, he decided he's going to stay, and so he joined my band

ctx.x: Dave Duncan, okay boy, white, but he really had us in good condition and everybody got so that they liked him. Bruce Steele then came into the Tulsa club and the waiters and everybody started to talk about my group, and then one Grant Williams--I don't know if you heard, he played something on the style of Floyd Smith, guitar, and just like a lot of the guys, you know, how hard it was on the road, well I was just kind of stationary there, there wasn't much money, but they said they'd rather have a little money…
originally out of Detroit, known as Fats Walls.
